description: Free lightweight UK market entry readiness snapshot for an SME. Returns key UK regulators, common entry barriers, an opportunity note tailored to the sector, and sensible first steps, plus a link to Entrida's full Market Entry Assessment. Use this whenever an SME asks about UK expansion, importing to the UK, or evaluating UK entry.

products.description: 1–2 sentences on what they make / sell.

sector.description: Sector or product line, e.g. 'food', 'textile', 'automotive parts', 'e-commerce'.

target_uk_segment.description: Target UK buyer or channel, e.g. 'independent grocers', 'Amazon UK DTC', 'tier-2 automotive suppliers'.
